provenance.attribution: Created by RunDiffusion in collaboration with Team Juggernaut (Kandoo) - Juggernaut X Hyper (v10) SFW/SAFE checkpoint for SDXL.
provenance.data_provenance_notes: RunDiffusion describes Juggernaut X Hyper as trained 'from the ground up' using a GPT-4 Vision captioning tool by LEOSAM, with an expanded/cleaner dataset and improved shot classifications. The model card lists SDXL 1.0 (stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0) as the base model. Specific training dataset sources are not disclosed.

provenance.attribution: Created by aiangelgallery (Civitai user) - AI Angel Mix series by aiangelgallery, originally published August 18, 2023.
provenance.data_provenance_notes: SD 1.5 checkpoint merge blending CyberRealistic, epiCRealism, A-Zovya Photoreal, majicMIX realistic/fantasy, and others for realistic/fantasy generation with emphasis on Western/Asian subjects and Thai features. Trained entirely from publicly released checkpoints.

provenance.attribution: Created by albedobond - AlbedoBase XL series by albedobond, originally published February 4, 2024.
provenance.data_provenance_notes: AlbedoBase XL v2.1 is an SDXL 1.0 checkpoint merge by albedobond using a custom merging algorithm. It merges many curated checkpoints and LoRAs (across anime/realism/artistic/NSFW/base) into an all-in-one model; VAE is included and the refiner is described as unnecessary.

provenance.attribution: Created by SG_161222 - RealVisXL V5.0 series by SG_161222, originally published September 2, 2024.
provenance.data_provenance_notes: RealVisXL V5.0 is an SDXL Lightning checkpoint merge by SG_161222 combining multiple models such as DreamShaper XL, Juggernaut XL, Noosphere, and HelloWorld XL to achieve high photorealism across SFW and NSFW content.

provenance.attribution: Developed by Stability AI — Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) Base 1.0.
provenance.data_provenance_notes: Official SDXL 1.0 base checkpoint released by Stability AI. The public model card does not enumerate specific training dataset sources; it points to the SDXL technical report for methodology details.

provenance.attribution: Developed by Stability AI — Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) Refiner 1.0.
provenance.data_provenance_notes: Official SDXL 1.0 Refiner checkpoint by Stability AI, designed for the final denoising steps in the SDXL two-stage pipeline. The public model card does not enumerate specific training dataset sources; see the SDXL technical report for details.

provenance.attribution: Published by LAION; OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 trained by Romain Beaumont (training run credited to Stability AI compute).
provenance.data_provenance_notes: OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 trained on the 2B-sample English subset of LAION-5B (LAION-2B). Dataset is uncurated; LAION advises caution and research-oriented use.

provenance.attribution: Published by LAION; model training done by Mitchell Wortsman using OpenCLIP (ViT-bigG/14).
provenance.data_provenance_notes: Trained on LAION-5B's 2B English subset (LAION-2B) and partially fine-tuned on LAION-A (aesthetic-filtered, pHash-deduplicated). Dataset is large and uncurated; intended for research use.

provenance.attribution: Created by Tencent AI Lab (tencent-ailab) - IP-Adapter (IP-Adapter Plus for SD 1.5).
provenance.data_provenance_notes: IP-Adapter Plus for Stable Diffusion 1.5; conditions SD on patch-level image embeddings from OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 via a lightweight adapter, with the base diffusion model kept frozen.

provenance.attribution: Created by Tencent AI Lab (tencent-ailab) - IP-Adapter (IP-Adapter Plus for SDXL, ViT-H variant).
provenance.data_provenance_notes: IP-Adapter Plus weights for SDXL that condition generation on patch-level image embeddings from an OpenCLIP ViT-H image encoder via a lightweight adapter (image-prompt conditioning for a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model).

provenance.attribution: Developed by Stability AI - Control-LoRA Depth (rank 128).
provenance.license: Stability AI Control-LoRA Community License Agreement
provenance.data_provenance_notes: Stability AI Control-LoRA depth (rank 128): low-rank finetuning of ControlNet for depth-guided generation. Trained on MiDaS dpt_beit_large_512 depth maps and further fine-tuned using ClipDrop’s Portrait Depth Estimation outputs.

provenance.attribution: Likely by xinsir - ControlNet Depth for SDXL (diffusers-format weights).
provenance.data_provenance_notes: Diffusers-format ControlNet for SDXL. Filename+size match xinsir/controlnet-depth-sdxl-1.0 (Apache-2.0), which accepts Zoe/MiDaS depth maps. Upstream page does not specify training dataset sources.
